Priya (prod-config): Heads-up: planning an operator bulk-edit of runtime flags tomorrow 09:00 PT for tenant-anchored quotas. Need to ensure console + API give a safe preview and clear rollback path. Quick questions: what minimal diffs should we show? and what telemetry baseline do we snapshot so we can detect regressions?

Ben (console): +1. We should show a compact diff (added/removed/changed) + a per-flag impact estimate (approx requests affected, avg latency delta if routing changes). Preview mode that does a dry-run and produces an artifact ID would be ideal.

Anna (ops): For rollbacks, operator-friendly dropdown: revert to previous snapshot or revert by artifact ID. Also we need an ephemeral lock so two people don't apply overlapping bulk edits.

Dan (telemetry): Agree on snapshotting pre-change traffic for: sample rate, avg_latency_95, error_rate_5xx, and quota_consume_rate. Compare post-change for first 10m/1h windows. We should also capture cohort-level traces for top-3 tenants impacted.

Priya (prod-config): Example operator payload we'll run via API: ```json
{
  "changes": [
    {"flag": "route_by_cost", "from": "0.1", "to": "0.2"},
    {"flag": "quota_slice", "op": "increase", "value": "+10%"}
  ],
  "dry_run": true
}
```
Can console generate that artifact + preview without applying? If so lets record artifact_id and a snapshot id.

Ben (console): Yes — proposal: console runs a dry-run that writes a preview artifact (preview_id) + baseline_snapshot_id. UI shows a 2-column diff and estimated affected RPS. Also add a tiny CTA: "Require approvals: X" so approvals are captured.

Anna (ops): Important: operator locks should be advisory but visible in UI and via API header `X-Preview-Artifact`. Also we need a graceful abort window: if any shard reports >2% error uplifts in first 15m, auto-pause and notify oncall.

Dan (telemetry): For auto-pause we need sampling hooks. Suggest we instrument preview runs to spawn a telemetry job that subscribes to the preview_id and emits a small report. Format: `preview_id, baseline_snapshot, metric, delta_pct` every 1m.

Priya (prod-config): Who owns retention for baseline snapshots? We want to keep for 30d for audit and comparison. Also need a small replay tool to run the same diff against synthetic traffic for staging.

Ben (console): Ownership: config-service owns snapshot storage + index. Console will surface and allow export. We'll add TTL=30d and manual preserve. For replay: create `preview_id` -> `replay_job` link that runs on staging cluster with canned traffic.

Anna (ops): Edge-case: bulk edits that touch 10k flags will explode diffs and telemetry. Suggest we require batching for >500 flags and force operator confirmation + ops-runbook link.

Dan (telemetry): Telemetry gap: currently we don't correlate previews with traces. We'll need a lightweight tag `preview_id` injected into trace propagation so we can slice spans. That requires a small header plumbing across gateway.

Priya (prod-config): OK action items: 1) Ben to prototype preview artifact + UI diff (POC by EOD Fri). 2) Dan to spike trace tagging and sample report schema. 3) Anna to write operator-lock and auto-pause rules and doc the batching rule. 4) I'll coordinate rollout and approvals.

Ben (console): Ack. I'll add `preview_id` artifact and the dry-run endpoint `POST /api/v1/config/preview` returning `{preview_id, baseline_snapshot_id, estimate}`. UI wireframes first.

Dan (telemetry): I'll propose a small report proto: `preview_report = { preview_id, snapshot_id, ts, metrics: [{name, baseline, current, delta_pct}] }`. Will send PR for collector changes.

Anna (ops): I'll draft the runbook snippet for auto-pauses (include thresholds and who to page). Also add the advisory lock behaviour.

config-bot: Reminder — scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 09:00-10:00 PT for the config-service. Please avoid breaking changes during that window. :rotating_light:

Priya (prod-config): Great. One more: console should surface a tiny timeline with the baseline snapshot timestamp, preview created ts, applied ts, and revert ts (if any). That helps audits.

Ben (console): Yep — timeline, artifact links, and an "export preview" button (json + estimate). Will add a confirmation modal that shows a short checklist: approvals present, shard batch size, auto-pause thresholds.

Dan (telemetry): Also can we add a lightweight trend sparkline per-flag in the preview diff showing baseline vs expected? Might be noisy but helpful for high-impact flags.

Anna (ops): Keep sparkline optional. Focus on clear stop conditions first.

Priya (prod-config): Thanks team. If you can put short notes in the PRs that reference `preview_id:1729902461` I'll consolidate.

Ben (console): Will do. :thumbsup: 

Anna (ops): Thanks.

Dan (telemetry): On it.

config-bot: Ticket created: CFG-1123 "Preview artifacts + telemetry hooks for operator bulk-edit" assigned to Ben, Dan, Anna, Priya. Link: https://tickets.internal/CFG-1123

Priya (prod-config): Closing thread — will follow up with schedule. Thanks everyone.
